hits.snippet: ## **Marlow Town Council launches new Community Fund to support local ideas and events** Marlow Town Council has launched its new Community Fund, designed to support local community organisations, charities and clubs delivering projects, events and new ideas that benefit the town and its residents. The Community Fund will provide Community Grants of up to£1,500 per organisation per financial year, with three application rounds per year to ensure projects taking place at different times of year can be supported. The scheme was launched on 3rd February 2026, initially as a pilot, allowing the Council to gather valuable learning and feedback to shape how the scheme operates going forward~~.~~ The aim is to gain a wider perspective on the funds required and to implement a grant process that is fair and transparent. The £30k Grant Fund is open to registered not-for-profit organisations delivering community-focused activity aligned with the Town Council’s vision and priorities. Applications will be assessed for their community impact, innovation and the ability to deliver.
